source.availability: frozen before signal values; no download-failure cohort fallback

geometry.annotation_reader: FreeSurfer annotation table indices, orig_ids=False; original names and packed color-table identity preserved in source bytes
geometry.cortical_parcel_order: included annotation-table indices in ascending order within L then R
geometry.catalogue: all original annotation-table rows plus -1 if actually observed
geometry.centroid: float64 equal-weight mean of stored pial vertex coordinates, no affine/resampling/area weighting
geometry.distance: Euclidean straight-line distance between centroids; includes interhemispheric edges; not cortical geodesic or tract length
geometry.coordinate_frame: native FreeSurfer SurfaceRAS (tkRAS) by documented pial-export convention; literal GIFTI dataspace=UNKNOWN, xformspace=3, identity matrix retained; not a claim of MNI coordinates
geometry.vertex_correspondence: documented canonical fsaverage5 provenance; not independently re-derived from raw anatomy; equal dimensions alone are insufficient
geometry.vertex_correspondence_limit: Canonical fsaverage5 index correspondence is supported by released preprocessing/atlas provenance and structural checks, not an independent byte comparison to the original installed FreeSurfer6 mesh or a new registration.

temporal.frame_selection: all released frames in original order; no censoring/interpolation/concatenation
temporal.parcellation: convert source vertices to float64 BEFORE equal-weight mean accumulation
temporal.confound_missingness: all 13 columns finite on every retained frame; no imputation
temporal.detrending: both signals and confounds: remove column mean and projection onto centered frame index 0..T-1

filter.application: same zero-phase forward/backward SOS filtering on detrended signals and confounds
filter.initial_state: steady state scaled to the extended endpoint for each forward/backward pass

temporal.nuisance_standardization: after filtering, center each nuisance column and divide by population SD; SD<eps uses 1
temporal.nuisance_projection: pivoted economic QR of standardized filtered nuisance; retain Q columns where abs(diag(R))>100*float64 epsilon; subtract Q@(Q.T@filtered_signal)
temporal.final_standardization: recenter residual and divide by sample SD ddof=1 only for valid parcels

parcel_validity.constant_input: all original parcel-mean time samples exactly equal

temporal.frame_count: Use actual subject-specific released frames; do not infer/pad/truncate from raw total scan duration. Source structural gate found171 with152 and sub-10524 with128; no duration-based exclusion.

fd.first_row: if source is n/a/empty include no value; if finite nonnegative include its actual value
fd.later_rows: must be finite and nonnegative; missing later rows fail precondition
fd.sum: sum only defined source FD values in float64
fd.qc_rule: strictly less than threshold on unrounded source mean
fd.qc_interpretation: restriction, not motion matching; no BOLD frame removal
fd.source_measurement: released Power-style sum of absolute successive translations plus radius-50-mm-scaled rotations; no FD recomputation from rounded export

connectivity.correlation: empirical Pearson: centered dot product divided by centered L2 norms; no shrinkage
connectivity.roundoff_rule: abs(r)<=1+1e-12 may be clamped to [-1,1]; larger overshoot fails
connectivity.edge_valid: both cortical endpoint parcel statuses ok in that subject
connectivity.common_valid: edge_valid true in EVERY selected subject
connectivity.common_set_usage: fixed for all subject summaries and every crude/adjusted/QC-restricted model
connectivity.edge_order: upper triangle i<j of canonical included parcel axis
connectivity.undefined_array_value: NaN ONLY for raw_r/fisher_z at false edge_valid; no infinities

distance_quantiles.method: linear: sorted d, h=(E-1)*p, linear interpolation between floor(h) and ceil(h)
distance_quantiles.family: only common-valid edges across all 172 selected subjects
distance_quantiles.middle: all other common edges including exact quantile ties
distance_quantiles.no_common_edges: q1/q2 null, zero bins; mean/short/long FC null; no edge-family substitution

connectivity.subject_summaries: unweighted mean Fisher-z over each fixed common-valid family; empty family yields null

models.solver: float64 SVD or mathematically equivalent QR/pseudoinverse; beta=Xplus@y; no inverse normal-equations requirement
models.contrast_estimability: e_diagnosis projection residual onto retained right-singular row space has L2<=100*max(n,p)*eps; full column rank is not required
models.covariance: SSE/df times Xplus@Xplus.T; classical homoskedastic, not Welch/HC3
models.ci95: estimate +/-1.96*SE; normal-Wald, not finite-sample t interval
models.residual_zero_rule: exact constant y gives diagnosis estimate0 and SSE0; otherwise residual L2<=10*max(n,p)*eps*max(centered_y_L2,float64_tiny) is numerical zero SSE, with raw residuals retained privately

status_details.rank_deficient: diagnosis contrast not estimable, not merely redundant nuisance
status_details.zero_se: identified estimate and SE0/SSE0/CI retained; t/p null

models.excluded_edge_record: counts/rank/df=0, all floating inference blank; qcfc excluded_not_common
models.invalid_model_record: preserve actual n/group counts/rank/df; estimate,se,ci,t,p,sse null when diagnosis unidentified or residual df unavailable
models.constant_response: if identifiable with positive df, estimate0,se0,sse0,ci[0,0],t/p null
models.empty_response_bin: Retain actual requested model cohort counts/design rank/df; all inference including SSE null. Do not recompute edge family or subject selection.

descriptive.qcfc: Pearson across all selected subjects of original mean FD and common-edge Fisher-z; non-common edges excluded
descriptive.pearson_constant_rule: exactly constant values or zero centered L2 produce undefined correlation
descriptive.map_correlation: Pearson across common edges with both finite model t and finite QC-FC; descriptive r only, no p
descriptive.edge_threshold: strict abs(t)>2 on finite t only; report defined/undefined counts and finite denominator
descriptive.patient_higher: t>2 among thresholded; fraction null if none

axes.subject_id: Exact original participants.tsv identifier, e.g. sub-10159; no arbitrary digit extraction or aliasing.
axes.source_participant_row: Zero-based original participants.tsv data-row index, not the selected-cohort index.
axes.parcel_id: Hemisphere L or R plus original annotation-table row index, e.g. L:1. Annotation table and surface ordering must first pass the structural gate.
axes.parcel_axis: All explicitly included cortical parcels, L then R, ascending original annotation-table row index within hemisphere.
axes.edge_id: Zero-based lexicographic upper-triangle index on the canonical included cortical parcel axis; a candidate edge exists even if later computationally invalid for one or more participants.
axes.subject_axis: Lexicographically sorted exact selected source subject IDs.
axes.array_order: Axes may be reordered if identity arrays and every dependent array are reordered consistently; CSV row/column order is not graded. No duplicate or missing identity is allowed.

cohort.csv.rows: Exactly the 177 source candidates satisfying source rest=1 and diagnosis in SCHZ/CONTROL, including the five predeclared unavailable controls.
cohort.csv.rule: Availability comes from the frozen source ledger, not the current download outcome; all 172 selected files must subsequently verify or execution fails. Flags are explicit booleans/0-or-1, never missing.

parcels.csv.rows: Every original annotation legend row in both hemispheres, including excluded entries, plus any source-observed unassigned label if present. Structural gate fixes exact representation before signals.
parcels.csv.centroids: Equal-weight original pial-coordinate means for every nonempty label, including excluded labels. Empty label has blank centroid fields. Units/frame are source metadata, not inferred millimetres.

edges.csv.rows: Every unordered pair of included cortical parcels exactly once, including computationally non-common edges.
edges.csv.rule: Distances are Euclidean pial-centroid distances. Common validity requires both endpoints valid for every selected subject. Quantiles use only common-valid distances. Strict d<q1 and d>q2; ties remain middle. Categories derive from unrounded original-source calculations.

connectivity.csv.fd: Mean over the declared defined FD rows; an undefined first row is omitted, not replaced by zero. Every later FD must be finite/nonnegative. All BOLD frames remain. Strict QC membership follows unrounded source mean FD.
connectivity.csv.fc: Unweighted Fisher-z means over the same common-valid edge/bin sets for every participant. Empty bin yields blank mean, not zero or silent replacement.
connectivity.csv.rank: Public pivoted-QR nuisance-span rule. Rank and threshold reported; factor signs/pivot order are not participant-output requirements.

subject_edge_fc.npz.format: Primitive NumPy arrays loadable with allow_pickle=False; no object arrays.

arrays.parcel_id: Unicode[P] exact included cortical parcel IDs
arrays.parcel_original_centered_l2: float64-compatible[S,P], finite/nonnegative original centered parcel-signal norm
arrays.parcel_residual_l2: float64-compatible[S,P], finite/nonnegative post-cleaning centered residual norm before sample-z-scoring
arrays.raw_r: float64-compatible[S,E], Pearson coefficient where both endpoints valid; otherwise NaN exactly as a declared undefined sentinel
arrays.fisher_z: float64-compatible[S,E], atanh(clip(raw_r,-0.999,0.999)) where valid; otherwise NaN
arrays.edge_valid: bool[S,E], true iff both source parcel statuses are ok
arrays.fisher_clipped: bool[S,E], true iff valid and unrounded abs(raw_r)>0.999; false for invalid

subject_edge_fc.npz.undefined_rule: NaN is allowed ONLY in raw_r/fisher_z at explicitly false edge_valid cells. Infinity, finite fabricated substitutes in undefined cells, or NaN at valid cells are invalid. No other required numeric array may contain nonfinite values.
subject_edge_fc.npz.rule: All subject-specific valid candidate edges are reported, not only the common subset. Every common edge remains identical across crude, adjusted, and QC-restricted analyses. Raw-r/source binding prevents affine or Fisher-transform forgeries.

edge_stats.csv.rows: Exactly two rows per candidate edge, keyed all_crude or all_fd_adjusted; non-common rows remain with explicit excluded status.
edge_stats.csv.effect: Signed diagnosis coefficient, SCHZ=1/CONTROL=0, classical homoskedastic OLS SE, normal-Wald estimate+/-1.96SE interval, two-sided t-reference p with declared residual df. No Welch interchange.
edge_stats.csv.undefined_rule: Excluded edge rows have all count/rank/df fields0 and floating inference fields blank. Invalid model rows preserve actual n/group counts/rank/df, with estimate/se/CI/t/p/SSE blank. zero_se preserves identified estimate, se0, interval and SSE0, with t/p blank.
edge_stats.csv.qcfc: Across-all-subject Pearson(mean FD, edge Fisher-z), repeated identically on both model rows for convenient joining. Undefined status/value must agree with original-source support.

fields.distance_bins: object {q1,q2,n_short,n_middle,n_long}; q values in source pial coordinate units, both null if no common-valid edges
fields.group_means: exact measure keys mean_fc,short_range_fc,long_range_fc,mean_fd; each {SCHZ: nullable finite mean,CONTROL: nullable finite mean}
fields.short_range_effects: exact keys all_crude,all_fd_adjusted,qc_fd_lt_0_2; each effect record below
fields.edgewise_abs_t_gt_2: exact keys all_crude,all_fd_adjusted; each threshold-summary record below
fields.group_map_vs_qcfc: exact keys all_crude,all_fd_adjusted; each correlation record below

effect_record.df: integer n-rank, or 0 if no rows
effect_record.ci95: length2 nullable values; estimate+/-1.96SE when identified
effect_record.sse: nullable nonnegative residual sum of squares

threshold_summary_record.patient_higher_fraction: n_patient_higher/n_abs_t_gt_2; null if no thresholded edges

correlation_record.r: nullable signed descriptive Pearson; no edge-independent p-value

group_stats.json.rule: Nullability is determined by source support/algebra, not an expected scientific pattern. QC membership, threshold categories, and undefined support are source-authoritative despite tolerated numeric rounding. No chance=.05, required significance, direction, or attenuation field.

run_metadata.json.source_sha256: Closed path->SHA256 map exactly matching all pinned analysis inputs; no invented extra sources.
run_metadata.json.method_contract: Closed copy of the full public method object, including geometry/cleaning/OLS/tolerance definitions; type-aware comparison, bool is not numeric.

atlas.rule: Required closed source-observed atlas object below, verified against the actual original annotation and pial inputs. These conventions distinguish literal headers from provenance-inferred coordinate units.

required_value.coordinate_frame: native FreeSurfer SurfaceRAS (tkRAS) by documented pial-export convention; literal GIFTI dataspace=UNKNOWN, xformspace=3, identity matrix retained; not a claim of MNI coordinates

source_observed.subjects: Exactly172 order-free records {subject_id,n_frames,n_vertices_left,n_vertices_right,n_confounds_rows,tr_s,surface_dtype_left,surface_dtype_right}; original header-derived values, dtype strings float32, per-subject frame counts preserved.

run_metadata.json.software: Nonempty string->nonempty string object reporting actual implementation, not required to equal oracle package versions.
run_metadata.json.extras: Harmless extra top-level or descriptive source_observed fields accepted; source identity/method objects and named statistical-model families remain closed.

findings.md.rule: Nonempty human-readable findings. No regex keywords, causal conclusion, attenuated effect, near-null result, or significance required. Scientific limitations belong in instruction and human review.

tolerances.counts_ids_flags_categories: exact source identity and unrounded categorical decisions

parsing.csv_flags: true/false or numeric0/1 accepted; no other nonempty strings
parsing.csv_integral: finite exact integral notation allowed, including scientific notation
parsing.json_numbers: finite numbers only, bool is not a number; undefined is null
parsing.numerical_categories: source-authoritative unrounded membership/validity/bin/threshold categories; tolerable serialized rounding must not change them
parsing.software: honest nonempty strings, not required to match oracle versions
parsing.extra_fields: harmless CSV/metadata descriptions accepted; required numeric axes/models and parsed method/source identity are closed

failure.source_integrity_or_schema: failed_precondition and nonzero exit; never refetch or alter selected cohort
failure.scientifically_undefined: complete accountable artifacts with prescribed undefined statuses, not fabricated numbers
failure.existing_output: refuse preexisting/symlinked destinations; source, public output and private receipt roots must be distinct and nonnested
